source.title: fix(roadmap): refine blocks an item with an open dependency (#3696)

criteria: A test: a complete proposal with one open dependency gives `NextStep.BLOCKED` and that number, and the item does not get Status Ready.
A test: the same proposal with a closed dependency gives `NextStep.READY`.
A test: a blocked item is refined again after its last blocker closes, and it reaches Ready.

`_refinable` (`refine.py:1713`) selects a Ready item only when it has no refine section or holds a covering tool that no round asked about, so a later round does not read these 9 items again. The change adds a selection rule for a Ready item with an open dependency, or one `devops roadmap refine --item <n>` run for each of the 9 items follows the merge.
After that step, each of the 9 items that still has an open dependency reads Status New, `refine.next_step` blocked, and `refine.blocked_by` set.
